title: Streaming & Online Reductions
description: Process unbounded data with bounded memory: running counters, dedup-as-you-go, and stateful single-pass scans. The patterns behind log aggregation, anomaly detection, and event-stream analytics that don't fit in RAM.
outcomes: You'll process unbounded data streams with bounded memory, dedupe events in flight, maintain running statistics with single-pass accumulators, and recognise when a streaming reduction beats a batch re-scan.
